meanings.explanation: [New York] is a very big city in the United States, famous for its tall buildings, yellow taxis, and places like Central Park and the Statue of Liberty.

examples.english: My family went to [New York] last summer and saw the Statue of Liberty.
examples.chinese: 我家去年夏天去了[纽约]，看了自由女神像。

examples.english: [New York] has many tall buildings and busy streets full of people.
examples.chinese: [纽约]有很多高楼和热闹的街道，街上到处都是人。

examples.english: I want to visit [New York] one day and play in Central Park.
examples.chinese: 我想有一天去[纽约]玩，在中央公园里玩耍。

meanings.explanation: You say [at last] when something you have been waiting or hoping for finally happens.

examples.english: It rained all morning, but the sun came out [at last].
examples.chinese: 雨下了一整个上午，不过太阳[终于]出来了。

examples.english: We waited a long time, and the bus arrived [at last].
examples.chinese: 我们等了好久，公交车[终于]来了。

examples.english: My birthday is [at last] here, and I am so excited!
examples.chinese: 我的生日[终于]到了，我好开心！

meanings.explanation: If someone or something [is part of] a group, organization, or activity, they are included in it or belong to it.

examples.english: I [am part of] the school art club and I love drawing with my friends.
examples.chinese: 我是学校美术俱乐部的[一员]，我喜欢和朋友们一起画画。

examples.english: This little river [is part of] the park where we play every day.
examples.chinese: 这条小河是我们每天玩耍的公园的[一部分]。

examples.english: My dad says helping with dinner [is part of] being a good family member.
examples.chinese: 爸爸说帮忙做晚饭是做好家庭[成员]的一部分。

meanings.explanation: If people [agree on] something, they make a decision together after talking about it, or they share the same idea about it.

examples.english: We [agree on] a place to eat dinner tonight.
examples.chinese: 我们[商定]了今晚吃饭的地方。

examples.english: My friends and I [agree on] the rules for our club.
examples.chinese: 我和朋友们[商定]了俱乐部的规则。

examples.english: Mom and Dad [agree on] where to go on holiday.
examples.chinese: 爸爸妈妈[商定]了去哪里度假。

meanings.explanation: [Egypt] is a country in northeastern Africa, famous for its ancient civilization and great stone pyramids.

examples.english: The most famous ancient pyramids are located in [Egypt].
examples.chinese: 最著名的古金字塔坐落于[埃及]。

examples.english: My dad took a vacation to [Egypt] last summer holiday.
examples.chinese: 我爸爸去年暑假去[埃及]度假了。

examples.english: [Egypt] has one of the longest and most interesting histories of any country.
examples.chinese: [埃及]拥有世界上最悠久也最有趣的历史之一。

meanings.explanation: [England] is a country in Europe that is part of the United Kingdom.

examples.english: My pen pal lives in [England].
examples.chinese: 我的笔友住在[英格兰]。

examples.english: Last summer, we flew to [England] for a holiday.
examples.chinese: 去年夏天，我们坐飞机去[英格兰]度假。

examples.english: [England] is famous for its green hills and old castles.
examples.chinese: [英格兰]以其翠绿的山丘和古老的城堡闻名。

meanings.explanation: If you are [busy], you have a lot of things to do and are working hard.

examples.english: My mom is [busy] cooking in the kitchen.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈正在厨房里[忙着]做饭。

examples.english: The children are [busy] doing their homework.
examples.chinese: 孩子们正在[忙着]做作业。

examples.english: Dad is too [busy] to play with me today.
examples.chinese: 爸爸今天太[忙]了，没空陪我玩。

meanings.explanation: If you [busy] yourself with something, you spend time doing it to keep occupied.

examples.english: Grandpa [busies] himself in the garden every morning.
examples.chinese: 爷爷每天早上都在花园里[忙活]。

examples.english: She [busied] herself with tidying up her room.
examples.chinese: 她[忙着]收拾自己的房间。

examples.english: He [busies] himself reading storybooks after school.
examples.chinese: 他放学后[忙着]看故事书。

meanings.explanation: When a dream, wish, or prediction [comes true], it actually happens or becomes real.

examples.english: I hope my birthday wish will [come true].
examples.chinese: 我希望我的生日愿望能[实现]。

examples.english: Her dream of becoming a singer finally [came true].
examples.chinese: 她想当歌手的梦想终于[成真]了。

examples.english: My mom says if you work hard, your wishes can [come true].
examples.chinese: 妈妈说只要你努力，愿望就能[实现]。

meanings.explanation: You use [as long as] to say that one thing can only happen if another thing happens or is true.

examples.english: You can play outside [as long as] you finish your homework first.
examples.chinese: 你可以出去玩，[只要]你先做完作业。

examples.english: I'll go to the zoo with you [as long as] it doesn't rain this Saturday.
examples.chinese: [只要]这周六不下雨，我就陪你去动物园。

examples.english: You can borrow my book [as long as] you give it back next week.
examples.chinese: [只要]你下周把书还我，你就可以借我的书。

meanings.explanation: A [clue] is a piece of information that helps you solve a problem, answer a question, or find something hidden or missing.

examples.english: My mom gave me a [clue] to help me find my lost stuffed bear.
examples.chinese: 妈妈给了我一条[线索]帮我找我丢失的玩具熊。

examples.english: We found a hidden [clue] during the treasure hunt at my birthday party.
examples.chinese: 我生日派对的寻宝游戏里，我们找到了一条隐藏的[线索]。

examples.english: Can you give me a [clue] about what surprise you have for me?
examples.chinese: 你能给我一点[线索]，说说你给我准备了什么惊喜吗？

meanings.explanation: If you [agree to do something], you say yes when someone asks you to do it, or you decide with others that you will do it.

examples.english: I [agree to help] my mom set the table for dinner.
examples.chinese: 我[同意帮]妈妈摆好晚饭的桌子。

examples.english: My friend [agreed to come] to my birthday party.
examples.chinese: 我的朋友[同意来]参加我的生日派对。

examples.english: We [agreed to share] our snacks during the trip.
examples.chinese: 我们[同意分享]旅途中的零食。

meanings.explanation: To [decide] means to make a choice or come to a conclusion after thinking.

examples.english: I can't [decide] which color to pick for my backpack.
examples.chinese: 我[决定]不了该选哪个颜色的书包。

examples.english: We [decided] to go to the park after school.
examples.chinese: 我们[决定]放学后去公园玩。

examples.english: Have you [decided] what to get Mom for her birthday?
examples.chinese: 你[决定]好给妈妈买什么生日礼物了吗？

meanings.explanation: A [corridor] is a long narrow passage inside a building with doors on each side that lead to rooms.

examples.english: The students walked down the [corridor] to their classroom.
examples.chinese: 学生们沿着[走廊]走向他们的教室。

examples.english: Our hotel room is at the very end of the [corridor].
examples.chinese: 我们酒店的房间在[走廊]的最尽头。

examples.english: Please walk quietly in the [corridor] so you don't disturb other classes.
examples.chinese: 请在[走廊]里轻声走路，不要打扰别的班上课。

meanings.explanation: A [discussion] is a conversation in which people talk about a particular topic together, sharing different ideas and opinions.

examples.english: We had a [discussion] about our favorite cartoon in class today.
examples.chinese: 今天我们在班上开展了一场关于最喜欢的动画片的[讨论]。

examples.english: My family had a [discussion] about where to go for our weekend trip.
examples.chinese: 我们一家人就周末去哪旅行展开了一场[讨论]。

examples.english: The teacher asked us to join the [discussion] about protecting trees.
examples.chinese: 老师邀请我们加入关于保护树木的[讨论]。

meanings.explanation: An [exhibition] is a public event where things such as paintings, photographs, or products are shown for people to look at.

examples.english: We went to see an art [exhibition] at the museum on Sunday.
examples.chinese: 我们周日去博物馆看了一个艺术[展览]。

examples.english: The school held a science [exhibition] in the gymnasium.
examples.chinese: 学校在体育馆举办了一场科学[展览]。

examples.english: There is a toy [exhibition] in the city center this week.
examples.chinese: 这周市中心有一个玩具[展览会]。

meanings.explanation: [Condition] is the state that something or someone is in, especially when talking about how good or bad it is.

examples.english: My old bike is in excellent [condition] because I take good care of it.
examples.chinese: 我的旧自行车保养得很好，[状况]很棒。

examples.english: The doctor said my heart is in good [condition].
examples.chinese: 医生说我的心脏[状况]良好。

examples.english: This house is in terrible [condition] and needs many repairs.
examples.chinese: 这栋房子[状况]很糟糕，需要很多维修。

meanings.explanation: A [condition] is a rule or requirement that must be accepted before something else can happen.

examples.english: One [condition] of the game is that everyone must follow the rules.
examples.chinese: 这个游戏的一个[条件]是每个人都必须遵守规则。

examples.english: She agreed to help me on the [condition] that I finish my homework first.
examples.chinese: 她同意帮我，[条件]是我得先写完作业。

examples.english: The store's return policy has several [conditions].
examples.chinese: 这家店的退货政策有好几个[条件]。

meanings.explanation: To [drag] something means to pull it along a surface with effort, especially because it is heavy or difficult to move.

examples.english: I helped my dad [drag] the big box into the house.
examples.chinese: 我帮爸爸把大箱子[拖]进了屋里。

examples.english: The little girl [dragged] her teddy bear behind her.
examples.chinese: 小女孩[拖着]她的泰迪熊走在后面。

examples.english: We had to [drag] the heavy table across the room.
examples.chinese: 我们不得不把沉重的桌子[拖]过房间。

meanings.explanation: An [explorer] is a person who travels to unknown or unfamiliar places in order to find out what is there.

examples.english: The famous [explorer] sailed across the big ocean to find new land.
examples.chinese: 这位著名的[探险家]乘船穿越大洋去寻找新陆地。

examples.english: My little brother dreams of becoming a space [explorer] when he grows up.
examples.chinese: 我弟弟梦想长大后成为一名太空[探险家]。

examples.english: This old storybook tells about a brave [explorer] in the Amazon rainforest.
examples.chinese: 这本旧故事书讲述了一位在亚马逊雨林里勇敢的[探险家]的故事。

meanings.explanation: To [investigate] something means to try to find out the truth about it, such as a crime, a problem, or an event, by carefully looking at the facts.

examples.english: The police came to [investigate] the strange noise last night.
examples.chinese: 警察昨晚来[调查]那个奇怪的声音。

examples.english: My little brother likes to [investigate] why ants carry food in a line.
examples.chinese: 我弟弟喜欢[探究]蚂蚁为什么排成一排搬食物。

examples.english: The teacher will [investigate] who broke the classroom window.
examples.chinese: 老师会[调查]是谁打破了教室的窗户。

meanings.explanation: A [lifeboat] is a small boat that is used to rescue people who are in danger at sea, or that is kept on a ship for use in an emergency.

examples.english: The captain told everyone to get into the [lifeboat] when the ship hit a big storm.
examples.chinese: 船遇到大风暴时，船长让大家赶紧上[救生艇]。

examples.english: The coast guard sent a [lifeboat] to help the family whose boat had broken down.
examples.chinese: 海岸警卫队派了一艘[救生艇]去帮助那家船坏掉的人。

examples.english: Before the trip, we practiced a [lifeboat] drill so everyone knew what to do.
examples.chinese: 出发前，我们演练了[救生艇]逃生，这样每个人都知道该怎么做。

meanings.explanation: If you [look around], you walk around a place and look at different things to see what is there.

examples.english: Let's [look around] the park to see what we can play with.
examples.chinese: 让我们在公园里[逛逛]，看看有什么好玩的。

examples.english: When you get to the new school, just [look around] first.
examples.chinese: 到了新学校，先[转转]吧。

examples.english: She likes to [look around] the toy store before buying anything.
examples.chinese: 她喜欢在玩具店里先[看看]，然后再决定买什么。

meanings.explanation: If something is [in bad condition], it is damaged, worn out, or not working properly because it is old or has been used a lot.

examples.english: This old teddy bear is [in bad condition].
examples.chinese: 这只旧泰迪熊[状况不佳]。

examples.english: The library book was [in bad condition] with torn pages.
examples.chinese: 那本图书馆的书[状况不佳]，书页都撕破了。

examples.english: My bike is [in bad condition] and needs new tires.
examples.chinese: 我的自行车[状况不佳]，需要换新轮胎。

examples.english: We found a wooden chair [in bad condition] on the street.
examples.chinese: 我们在街上发现了一把[状况不佳]的木椅子。

meanings.explanation: A [reminder] is something that helps you remember to do something or reminds you about something important.

examples.english: Mom put a [reminder] on the fridge so I wouldn't forget my homework.
examples.chinese: 妈妈在冰箱上贴了一张[提醒]纸条，这样我就不会忘记写作业了。

examples.english: My phone alarm is a [reminder] for me to drink water every hour.
examples.chinese: 手机闹钟每小时响一次，[提醒]我该喝水了。

examples.english: Thank you for the [reminder] about the school trip tomorrow.
examples.chinese: 谢谢你关于明天学校郊游的[提醒]。

meanings.explanation: A [passenger] is a person who travels in a car, bus, train, plane, or other vehicle but is not the driver or the person operating it.

examples.english: The bus stopped to let a [passenger] get off.
examples.chinese: 公交车停下来让一位[乘客]下车。

examples.english: My dad drives the car and I sit in the back as a [passenger].
examples.chinese: 爸爸开车，我坐在后面当[乘客]。

examples.english: All [passengers] must fasten their seat belts before the plane takes off.
examples.chinese: 所有[乘客]在飞机起飞前都必须系好安全带。

meanings.explanation: To [live on] means to use a particular amount of money or eat a particular type of food in order to survive and stay alive.

examples.english: Most people in the countryside [live on] fresh vegetables from their gardens.
examples.chinese: 乡下大多数人[靠]自家菜园的新鲜蔬菜生活。

examples.english: We [live on] my dad's salary in our family.
examples.chinese: 我们一家人[靠]我爸爸的工资生活。

examples.english: Many wild animals [live on] small plants and insects in the forest.
examples.chinese: 森林里很多野生动物[以]小型植物和昆虫为食。

meanings.explanation: If something is [off the coast], it is located in the sea at a short distance from the land or shoreline.

examples.english: There is a small island [off the coast] where many seabirds live.
examples.chinese: 有一座小岛在[近海]，那里住着很多海鸟。

examples.english: My uncle took us fishing on a boat [off the coast] last Saturday.
examples.chinese: 上周六叔叔带我们坐船去[近海]钓鱼。

examples.english: The ship dropped anchor [off the coast] and waited for morning.
examples.chinese: 船在[近海]抛锚，等待天亮。

meanings.explanation: A [reel] is a round cylindrical object used for winding things such as thread, film, or fishing line around.

examples.english: My mom keeps her sewing thread on a wooden [reel].
examples.chinese: 我妈妈把缝纫线绕在一个木质[线轴]上。

examples.english: We watched an old movie that was stored on a big metal [reel].
examples.chinese: 我们看了一部存放在大金属[胶片盘]里的老电影。

examples.english: Dad replaced the old [reel] on his fishing rod yesterday.
examples.chinese: 爸爸昨天换掉了鱼竿上的旧[渔轮]。

meanings.explanation: A [submarine] is a ship that can travel completely under the surface of the sea.

examples.english: I saw a huge [submarine] at the maritime museum.
examples.chinese: 我在海事博物馆看到了一艘巨大的[潜水艇]。

examples.english: The [submarine] slowly dove under the sea surface.
examples.chinese: 这艘[潜水艇]慢慢潜到了海面之下。

examples.english: Kids love reading stories about a talking [submarine].
examples.chinese: 孩子们喜欢读关于一艘会说话的[潜水艇]的故事。

meanings.explanation: If something [breaks into two], it separates or splits into two parts, often because of force or pressure.

examples.english: The cookie [broke into two] when I dropped it on the floor.
examples.chinese: 饼干掉到地上，[碎成了两半]。

examples.english: Be careful, or the branch will [break into two].
examples.chinese: 小心点，不然树枝会[断成两截]。

examples.english: The ice on the pond [broke into two] when we stepped on it.
examples.chinese: 我们踩上去的时候，池塘里的冰[裂成了两半]。

meanings.explanation: A [sink] is a large bowl-shaped fixture in a kitchen or bathroom that you use for washing your hands, dishes, or food.

examples.english: I washed my hands in the [sink].
examples.chinese: 我在[水槽]里洗了手。

examples.english: Mom put the dirty dishes in the [sink].
examples.chinese: 妈妈把脏盘子放进了[水槽]。

examples.english: Please don't leave your toys in the [sink].
examples.chinese: 别把你的玩具留在[水槽]里。

meanings.explanation: To [sink] means to go down below the surface of water or another liquid, or to move downward.

examples.english: A stone will [sink] to the bottom of the pond.
examples.chinese: 石头会[沉]到池塘底部。

examples.english: My feet [sink] into the soft sand at the beach.
examples.chinese: 我的脚[陷]进了海滩柔软的沙子里。

examples.english: The sun began to [sink] below the horizon.
examples.chinese: 太阳开始[落]到地平线以下。

meanings.explanation: To [wreck] something means to damage or destroy it so badly that it can no longer be used or is completely ruined.

examples.english: The little boy [wrecked] his new toy truck by hitting it with a hammer.
examples.chinese: 那个小男孩用锤子敲打，把新玩具卡车给[弄坏了]。

examples.english: A big storm [wrecked] our treehouse last night.
examples.chinese: 昨晚一场大暴风雨把我们的树屋[摧毁了]。

examples.english: Please be careful not to [wreck] your little sister's drawing.
examples.chinese: 请小心点，别把妹妹的画给[弄坏了]。

meanings.explanation: An [unsinkable] ship or object is designed so that it cannot sink in water.

examples.english: My little toy boat is [unsinkable] and always floats in the bathtub.
examples.chinese: 我的小玩具船是[不会沉]的，在浴缸里总漂在水面上。

examples.english: People called the Titanic an [unsinkable] ship, but it sank on its first trip.
examples.chinese: 人们把泰坦尼克号称为[永不沉没]的船，但它在首航中就沉没了。

examples.english: Mom's [unsinkable] cheerfulness makes everyone in the family happy.
examples.chinese: 妈妈那[打不垮]的乐观让家里每个人都很开心。

meanings.explanation: An [iceberg] is a very large piece of ice that floats in the sea, with most of it hidden under the water.

examples.english: We saw a huge [iceberg] floating in the ocean.
examples.chinese: 我们在海上看到了一座巨大的[冰山]。

examples.english: Most of an [iceberg] is hidden under the water.
examples.chinese: [冰山]的大部分都藏在水下。

examples.english: The explorer took a photo of a beautiful [iceberg].
examples.chinese: 探险家拍了一张漂亮的[冰山]照片。

meanings.explanation: A [diver] is a person who swims or works underwater, often using special equipment to help them breathe.

examples.english: The [diver] put on her mask and jumped into the clear blue water.
examples.chinese: [潜水员]戴上面镜，跳进了清澈湛蓝的水里。

examples.english: My uncle is a [diver] and he finds beautiful shells under the sea.
examples.chinese: 我叔叔是一名[潜水员]，他在海底能找到漂亮的贝壳。

examples.english: The [diver] wore a wet suit to keep warm in the cold ocean.
examples.chinese: [潜水员]穿着潜水服，在冰冷的海水里保暖。

meanings.explanation: A [shipwreck] is a ship that has been destroyed or sunk in an accident at sea.

examples.english: The divers found an old [shipwreck] full of treasure.
examples.chinese: 潜水员发现了一艘装满宝藏的古老[沉船]。

examples.english: We learned about a famous [shipwreck] in our history class.
examples.chinese: 我们在历史课上了解了一艘著名的[沉船]。

examples.english: The old [shipwreck] has been under the sea for many years.
examples.chinese: 那艘古老的[沉船]已经在海底待了很多年了。

meanings.explanation: If you are [on board] a ship, plane, train, or other vehicle, you are on or in it.

examples.english: All passengers please get [on board] the plane now.
examples.chinese: 所有乘客请现在[登机]。

examples.english: We were [on board] the ship when it started to rain.
examples.chinese: 开始下雨的时候我们已经[在船上]了。

examples.english: The captain asked all visitors to go [on board] before the ship left.
examples.chinese: 船长要求所有游客在开船前[上船]。

meanings.explanation: If you are [on board] with a plan, idea, or group, you agree to support it or join it.

examples.english: My mom is [on board] with our plan to have a picnic this Saturday.
examples.chinese: 我妈妈[赞成]我们这周六去野餐的计划。

examples.english: All my friends got [on board] with my idea to build a small treehouse.
examples.chinese: 我所有的朋友都[支持]我搭建小树屋的想法。

examples.english: At first she said no, but now she's [on board] with our trip.
examples.chinese: 她一开始不同意，但现在她[同意]我们的旅行了。
